cells.gaps: No source found says the government adopted the strategy: the ministry's own 2025 report says one was adopted, the roadmap was validated at a workshop in December 2025, and in September 2026 the strategy document was still being finalised. No body named to carry it out has been found.
cells.note: Rebuild 2026-11-26: a ministry reporting its own adoption of the strategy is not cabinet approval or formal validation (messages-for-bill 132), and a roadmap validated at a workshop is a draft. In September 2026 the strategy document was still being finalised, so stage 2.
